assessor: RTS governed build assessment — Official Docs Intake + Claim Extraction Adapter v1
rationale: H already owns deterministic old/new documentation comparison and fail-closed residual-change coverage, but it deliberately excludes source discovery/fetch and claim extraction. I adds only the missing upstream intake adapter: bounded provider allowlists, official index discovery, HTTPS fetch with redirect revalidation, deterministic text normalization, exact-anchor conservative claim extraction, coverage audit, and H-compatible bundle construction. It does not infer hidden model architecture, call model APIs, mutate runtime routing, or grant execution/profile/promotion authority.

assets.notes: Directly validate emitted transition-evidence-bundle/v1 against H schema and reuse exact claim/source boundaries.
Reuse exact external provenance, reference-only evidence, and non-authorizing semantics.

gaps: No component currently discovers and fetches provider official documentation into immutable H-compatible evidence bundles.
No component currently performs conservative exact-anchor contract claim extraction with an explicit coverage audit.

risks: Provider documentation hosts and redirects can change.
HTML pages can contain navigation/script noise that creates false claim signals.
Keyword extraction can overclassify marketing language or underclassify novel contract wording.
Unbounded discovery can become a crawler and create cost/load risk.
Partial fetch failures can be mistaken for complete evidence.
A valid documentation claim can still differ from actual model behavior and must remain a hypothesis.
